## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install kmacsolves in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure kmacsolves package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to kmacsolves
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/professorwug/kmacsolves):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/professorwug/kmacsolves.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/professorwug/kmacsolves)

``` sh
$ conda install -c professorwug kmacsolves
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/kmacsolves/)

``` sh
$ pip install kmacsolves
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/professorwug/kmacsolves)’s
[pages](https://professorwug.github.io/kmacsolves/). Additionally you
can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/professorwug/kmacsolves) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/kmacsolves/) respectively.
